source_note: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分
english_source_note: Integrating via Binary Expansion of the Variable
callout_id: 对自变量进行二进制展开求积分#6
english_title: Comparing Two Decimals in Base r
statement_en: Suppose two real numbers \\(a,b\\in(0,1)\\) have the same first \\(k\\) digits in their base-\\(r\\) expansions, with \\(k\\ge 1\\), and the \\((k+1)\\)-st digit satisfies \\(a_{k+1}>b_{k+1}\\). Then \\(a>b\\).
callout_body: 假设两个实数$a,b\in (0,1)$其$r$进制表示的前$k$位($k\geq 1$)都相等，第$k+1$位上的数字$a_{k+1}>b_{k+1}$，那么$a>b$.
